digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program (observability, gates, migrations, validation)
propositions: Bug provenance must be observable at creation and trend-queryable without requiring new user input.
Deterministic pre-LLM gates must enforce: raw git writes, unread config fields, wall-clock asserts, unchecked AC checkboxes, code-comment rot, and oversized bug fixes lacking plan-review attestation.
Production shell logic (reconcile-bridge, canary, probe, vote normalizer) must be migrated to Python per strangler-fig policy.
Reconciler transport must be typed end-to-end with property-test-pinned field asymmetries and deduplicated pagination iterators.
Canary/automation bug filing must follow hardened dedup pattern with documented bug-creation contract and deterministic dedup-key normalization.
Completion attestation signing must gracefully handle legacy (pre-normalized) material by grandfathering byte-exact hash matches to prevent false-negative certifiable skips.
